name: Feature Request

labels: enhancement

---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

**Example**: "As a developer using Fleet Commander, I want X so that I can Y."

## 🔧 Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like this feature to work.

### Example Usage

```bash
# Show how the feature would be used
./scripts/fleet-manager.sh your-new-command

# Or if it's a slash command
/your-new-command "example"
```

### Expected Output

```
What should the output look like?
```

## 🔀 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## 📊 Benefits

How will this feature improve the Fleet Commander workflow?

- [ ] Improves developer productivity
- [ ] Reduces context switching
- [ ] Enhances code quality
- [ ] Better error handling
- [ ] Easier onboarding
- [ ] Other: _______

## 🤔 Implementation Ideas

(Optional) Do you have ideas about how to implement this?

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I've checked [existing issues](https://github.com/yourusername/Fleet-Commander/issues) and discussions
- [ ] I've read the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] This feature aligns with Fleet Commander's philosophy
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this (optional)
